great-lakes-16-17-scatter-plot.png.description: Scatter plot showing mean monthly water levels in the Great Lakes over time, rising and falling over the course of 2016. A few lighter dots are present from after 2016 to hint at the nature of the curve.
great-lakes-16-17-scatter-plot.png.source: Created by the Bootstrap team, with data from https://lre-wm.usace.army.mil/ForecastData/WaterLevelData/GLHYD_data_metric.csv
